title: iberis carnosa subsp. embergeri
intro: Iberis carnosa subsp. embergeri, commonly known as Corsican rock rose, is a plant species that belongs to the family Brassicaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and skin conditions, thanks to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Iberis carnosa subsp. embergeri include relief from bronchitis, coughs, and sore throats, as well as its ability to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which work together to exhibit its medicinal effects.
